name: fix-vulns
description: Audits and fixes vulnerable dependencies in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Java/Kotlin and .NET projects (Dependabot alerts plus each ecosystem's own auditor) on a dedicated branch. Judges which flaws are actually reachable, applies the smallest safe upgrades, validates against a pre-upgrade baseline, and reports what was and was not fixed. Never commits or pushes without approval.
